EX-99.1 2 dp256929_ex9901.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Helus Pharma Announces Positive Topline Results from Phase 3 APPROACH Study evaluating HLP003 as Adjunctive Treatment in Major Depressive Disorder HLP003 achieved statistically significant and clinically meaningful results in the primary and key secondary endpoints starting as early as Day 2 and maintained at all time points -7.6 point placebo-adjusted change from baseline at Week 6 for the primary endpoint on the Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale (“MADRS”) (p< 0.0001) Durable effect maintained through Week 12 (key secondary endpoint) with a -7.0 point placebo-adjusted change from baseline on the MADRS (p< 0.0001) Robust and statistically significant response and remission rates starting as early as Day 2 and maintained at all time points HLP003 was generally well-tolerated This news release constitutes a “designated news release” for the purpose of the Company’s prospectus supplement dated December 30, 2025, to its short form base shelf prospectus dated September 17, 2025, as amended on December 19, 2025.

(Nasdaq: HELP) (Cboe CA: HELP) (“Helus Pharma” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company committed to improving the treatment landscape in mental health conditions through the development and commercialization of novel serotonergic agonists (“NSAs”), today announced positive topline results from APPROACH, its Phase 3 pivotal study evaluating HLP003 (deuterated psilocin), as an adjunctive treatment for adults with major depressive disorder (“MDD”).

The Company expects to report topline results from the EMBRACE trial in 4Q 2027. 2,3 EXTEND is the ongoing long-term extension study which will provide additional data on long-term safety, durability of effect, and the potential role of redosing.

Forward-looking statements in this news release include statements regarding the Company’s claim that the data demonstrate a therapeutic profile that has the potential to meaningfully improve outcomes for patients; expectations to report topline results from the EMBRACE trial in 4Q 2027; the potential regulatory approval and commercialization of HLP003; the APPROACH study’s potential to set higher expectations among clinicians treating patients who continue to experience depressive symptoms while on an anti-depressant; expectations of the EXTEND study, including the roll-in enrollment of participants from EMBRACE and APPROACH; HLP003 as a potential adjunctive treatment for MDD; and the Company’s plans to engineer proprietary drug discovery platforms, innovative drug delivery systems, novel formulation approaches and treatment regimens for mental health conditions; and the timing of any of the foregoing.
